description: This file is the main implementation for a modem simulator component within the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It handles command-line arguments, sets up logging, initializes modem simulators, manages socket communication for control commands, and runs the main server loop to process incoming requests.

classes.name: ModemSimulator
classes.description: Represents a modem simulator instance, responsible for simulating modem behavior and state management.

classes.name: ChannelMonitor
classes.description: Handles monitoring of communication channels between the server and modem simulator.

methods.name: ServerFdsFromCmdline
methods.description: Parses the command-line argument to extract and validate a list of file descriptors, returning a vector of SharedFD objects.

methods.name: ModemSimulatorMain
methods.description: Main function that initializes the modem simulator environment, sets up communication, and runs the server loop.
